description: District Energy Model is a Python multi-energy model for demand, generation, storage and optimisation at district and municipal scales. HSLU documents multiple applications, tutorials and a related municipal planning interface. The provider is HSLU CC TES, SWEET EDGE. Coverage: The model is generic but tailored to Switzerland and its municipality data. It outputs hourly and annual results; coverage and scenarios depend on the configured inputs. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The documentation explicitly identifies Apache 2.0 for source code. Upstream datasets retain separate terms. Limitations: The documentation is newly launched and some sections remain incomplete. Minimal setup for Swiss municipalities does not establish equal input coverage elsewhere. For simulation it supports municipal energy planning and comparisons of supply and storage options. Related resources: model-besos is a separate district-energy modelling environment. Its general wording does not cover HSLU DEM.
